notes.title: 2021-08-31 - Feature Updates!
notes.content:
- Added an option to always hire epic managers.

- Optimized client loading flow on iOS and web browsers. The game is now loading much faster. 

- Reworked the collectibles icon for easier recognition.

- Fixed a bug that caused some gacha rewards being only accessible after reload (outfits and party tokens).

- Fixed some wrong tagged gallery images.

- Prepared several events for the upcoming weeks.

- Optimizations and bug fixes.

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.34.352
notes.content:
- Carmen's Gacha is here! Check out her van packed with over 40 new outfits, 20 new styles and much more! One free grab every day!
- Balancing updates for collectible style chests. Increased the guaranteed amounts of rare and epic style cards. Legendary chests now always guarantee a legendary style card.
- Instant income items of the same type are now stacked in the inventory.
- Fixed a bug that caused the daily login reward to be stuck at day 255.
- Fixed a bug that caused the client to be stuck on an empty chest screen after opening style or gift chests.
- Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash in masquerade events if you tried to open rooms very fast without having enough masks.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes showed wrong amounts in the info bubbles on the phone tabs.
- Fixed a bug that prevented correct unlock of locations in activity events.
- Fixed a bug that caused multiple main menu buttons to be highlighted at the same time.
- Prepared several events for the upcoming weeks.
- Optimizations and bug fixes.

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.33.330

notes.content: Fixed game stuck while loading.

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.33.329
notes.content:
- Event chats now have their own category and are removed from the girl chats.
- Added back and next buttons in the Floor Manager popup to switch floors faster.
- After unlocking a new floor, you get a free manager if the VIP Pass is active.
- Improved performance of girl Tower Boost on all devices.
- Improved game loading times on all devices.
- Prepared several events for the upcoming weeks.
- Optimizations and bug fixes.

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.32.302
notes.content:
- Numbers in Masquerade Event rooms now show the amount of adjacent tokens AND bonus rewards.
- Added a new custom timeskip option.
- Gallery pictures are now displayed in the order the player unlocked them.
- Prepared several events for the upcoming weeks.

Beside the usual updates and changes we took a deep look in the guts of the game and fixed these issues:
- Rewards for prestiging are now correctly rewarded.
- Fixed a bug that reset bonus effects after switching towers.
- Fixed a bug in the collectibles where the global bonus would only work if the assigned tower was active.
- Fixed a bug that prevented mansion effects that target floors did not work correctly.
- Fixed a bug that calculated price reductions wrong (floors and barriers).
- Fixed a bug that prevented stacking of several boni of the same type.

- Fixed a bug where the Girl Boost overlay would appear multiple times.
- Fixed a bug where the full income factor wasn't always properly displayed.
- Prepared several events for the upcoming weeks.

notes.title: Patchnotes 2021-02-23 - Feature Updates!
notes.content:
- Ingame Tasks are here! Do all kinds of activities throughout the game and get rewards. 
- Fixed a bug where the displayed idle income didn't match with the received reward.
- Optimized the loading times of the game.
- Prepared several events for the upcoming weeks.

notes.title: Update Notes 2021-02-02
notes.content:
The game has been updated to bring you the latest updates and changes:

- All unclaimed rewards from past events are now automatically claimed on login. 

- Added more details to see which Style Cards were received when claiming random style card rewards. 

- Fixed a bug where progress notifications could interfere with a running Girl Click Boost or clicker event.

- Fixed a bug where the chat energy refill timer didn't account the already passed time.

- Fixed a bug where Rose didn't show up in the collection UI.

- Fixed a bug where the game crashed on a progress notification from a newly unlocked girl.

- Fixed a bug where changing the style of workers could crash the game.

- Prepared several events for the upcoming weeks.

- Several smaller optimizations and bug fixes.

- Sneak peek: A new event type is in the works to bring more dynamic to the overall event system.
